notes.title: Echoes of Mora DEMO IS LIVE! 🚨
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone!

We wanted to quickly deliver this update to you as we are currently pouring heart and soul into exhibiting Echoes of Mora at gamescom this week.[/p][p]Nonetheless, we have super important news to share with you:[/p][h1]Our demo for Echoes of Mora is now live on Steam and you can dive into the game straight away! 🎊[/h1][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3870460/Echoes_of_Mora_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The release trailer for the demo has premiered on the FYNG showcase and the demo is now part of the FYNG Steam event as well as the gamescom Steam event: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Find-Your-Next-Game-at-gamescom" style="button"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Find-Your-Next-Game-at-gamescom[/url][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamescom-2025?l=german" style="button" buttoncolor="#400080"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/gamescom-2025?l=german[/url]

Check out our awesome Trailer here:[/p][previewyoutube="QHgmZpOoLD0;full"][/previewyoutube][p]And if you are at gamescom, definitely come over to our booth at Home of Indies, Hall 10.2, E010 D011, to get some exclusive Echoes of Mora goodies! [/p][p][/p][p]The next steps after gamescom will be to implement all the feedback into the demo and improve the experience. You can submit any feedback through a submission form linked in the game or by joining our Discord and sharing your thoughts in the feedback and bugs channel! The bugs will be addressed and fixed in the coming weeks!

Thanks for reading and stay tuned for future updates! [/p][p] - the Selkies Team 🦭 [/p]

notes.title: Finishing touches for our gamescom Demo debut 🎨🖌️
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone! 👋
Before we proceed with updates from the game dev side, we have two big news for you! 📣[/p][h2]Echoes of Mora is part of the Debut Festival 2025!⭐[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/4aa6a8723e86d73f687d981c081c550e4696f15a.jpg"][/img]
Thank you so much [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gmdv/"]GameDev.ist[/url] for including our game! This is the first time Echoes of Mora is part of a Steam event and we couldn't be more excited! 😊🙏[/p][p][/p][h3]And the other big news is...[/h3][h2]...the Echoes of Mora Demo will release in less than TWO weeks! 🤯[/h2][p]We're thrilled to announce that the demo will be released simultaneously with our appearance at gamescom 2025—right here on Steam! So even if you can't visit us in person, you'll still be able to experience the demo at home (in PC-VR or PC-only mode).[/p][p]Stay tuned, the Steam demo page will go live soon![/p][p]Buuut for those of you who [i]are[/i] coming to gamescom in Cologne this year, here's where you can find us:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/682cd78ac320f1b1e18dc12c4df32444b2a65a46.png"][/img][/p][p]📍 Home of Indies, Hall 10.2, Booth E010 D011[/p][p]Come say hi and play the demo in VR or on PC (we've got two stations ready). Plus, we'll have some lovely merch waiting for you at our booth... 🔮🦭✨[/p][p]Make sure to follow us on social media to stay up to date with our gamescom journey, we'll definitely share some photos! 📸[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Now onto all the progress we've made since the last Dev Log:[/h3][p][/p][h2]🎨 Art[/h2][p]We've created a whole new area for you to explore—[b]Mora's House[/b]!
It's filled with carefully placed [b]furniture and decorations[/b], many of which subtly tell stories through environmental details. You can actually learn a lot about Mora's family just by observing how they used to live.[/p][p]Here's a screenshot of the [b]outside of the house[/b] (make sure to check out the inside in the demo! 👀):
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/22b6d8b737d184589850725e07c749962093ee7d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🏊 Animations[/h2][p]The PC mode finally has some [b]swimming [/b]and[b] idle animations[/b]! 
More animations, like holding and pointing at objects, will be added soon![/p][p](Oh, and we also added a magical new [b]barrier[/b] that encloses the demo area ✨): 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/fda3c561cb1834ef87d0d0436d832d17bf8f1c7d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🎬 Story & Music[/h2][p]The full story of the demo is now implemented, featuring [b]animated cutscenes[/b] of the most important characters, all brought to life by our talented [b]voice actors[/b].[/p][p]Besides that, we've added beautiful [b]background music[/b] throughout the demo, in both the game menu and the game itself![/p][p][b]And here's also an extra bit of exciting news:[/b][/p][p][i]We've been working on a [b]brand-new trailer[/b] for the demo! It'll be revealed soon, so keep your eyes peeled! 👀[/i][/p][p] [/p][h2]🖥️ UI[/h2][p]You can now follow all dialogue via [b]subtitles[/b]![/p][p]We've also added a first version of the [b]Credits[/b] in the main menu. On top of that, the UI has been further adapted to match the specific needs of the demo.[/p][p]Here's a screenshot where you can see the [b]subtitles[/b]:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/9152fcd382267d312b65c9f6520b452257caa1bc.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🐞 Bug Fixing[/h2][p]We've been mercilessly purging bugs, but a few sneaky ones are still slipping through. Want to help us catch them before the demo officially launches? Join our [url="https://discord.com/invite/cSBZ9ARjc2"]Discord[/url] and sign up for a [b]playtest[/b]![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Beyond the game itself, the Echoes of Mora [b]Steam page[/b] has received a [b]visual upgrade[/b] with colorful GIFs, new screenshots, and some refined text.[/p][p][/p][p]That's it for our [b]second Dev Log[/b]! 
We're super excited to showcase the demo at gamescom, and we're incredibly grateful for your support! Stay tuned for more updates! 💜[/p][p]- the Selkies Team 🦭[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129050/Echoes_of_Mora/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Big Steps toward the Demo! 🌀🔮
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, fellow underwater lovers! 🌊 We're kicking off this first Dev Log with huge news – something we've been quietly working toward for months...[/p][h2]A Demo Version is coming... and it's BIG! ✨[/h2][p]We're beyond excited to reveal that a public Demo of [i]Echoes of Mora[/i] is on the way! And this isn't just a quick preview – it's a full slice of the game that offers a real feel for what's to come.[/p][p]In the Demo you'll be able to:[/p][list][*][p]Explore roughly [b]one third of the full game world[/b], including a forest and lake environment, several points of interest, and different story locations[/p][/*][*][p]Play through the [b]first Echo scenes[/b] where you'll meet the main characters[/p][/*][*][p]Experience the [b]dialogue and interaction system[/b] we've been building[/p][/*][*][p]Get a full [b]intro to the game's story[/b] and tone[/p][/*][/list][p]More info about the Demo release date and the Demo Steam Page will follow soon![/p][h3]
[hr][/hr]Besides that – we're thrilled to provide you with fresh updates on our journey developing [i]Echoes of Mora[/i]! Things have been moving fast as we gear up for the Demo. Let's take a look at what we've been up to lately: [/h3][p][/p][h2]🎨 Art[/h2][p]We've been steadily improving the visuals of the world: sculpting and painting landscapes, adding erosion to make everything feel more natural, and swapping out blockout meshes for actual environment assets. That means trees, hand-placed rocks, bushes, and seaweed to make the world feel truly alive.[/p][p]Also, we officially kicked off asset production! We're currently filling the world with a mix of high-quality third-party assets and our own handmade custom meshes for individual and story-relevant elements. Here's a screenshot of a [b]Wayside Shrine[/b] that's now fully modeled and placed in-game:
 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/d5627eb2b15e378ef38452513a5522e4e5d6223a.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🛠️ Game Mechanics[/h2][p]We implemented an [b]inventory system[/b] both for the VR and PC mode – now it's possible to store several items while exploring the world. See the [b]VR inventory[/b] here:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/0af328d881d7415fd7143d554e3535ff47a0cc9f.gif"][/img][/p][p]
Our [b]interaction and player choice system[/b], which we previously used with placeholder text for testing, is now being integrated with real scenes from the actual script. That means we've started building proper in-game moments using final dialogue and voice lines. Players can [b]nod[/b], [b]shake their head[/b], or [b]point at objects[/b] to interact with Mora and respond to her questions. You can see the [b]nodding[/b] in action here:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/07ad4fcb741009e5f4f8da95409683c98dc4765d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🖥️ UI[/h2][p]We gave the User Interface a shiny new look by [b]revamping the main menu, pause menu[/b], and [b]various interface elements[/b]:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45194533/4ff20a5166c5348c4d64da0bd3a695126932a197.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🔮 Echo Sneak Peek[/h2][p]To see how it's all starting to come together, we prepared a short sneak peek of one Echo scene. This will be one of the first places where you'll really get to know the characters and see why the story plays a big role in Echoes of Mora:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="fuE1Dg7GidQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h2] [/h2][h2][hr][/hr]📣 Other News & Announcements[/h2][list][*][p]We have an official [b]Community Discord[/b] for Echoes of Mora! If you want early updates, behind-the-scenes peeks, or even access to future playtests, come hang out with us. It's also the best place to ask us questions directly! Join [url="https://discord.com/invite/cSBZ9ARjc2"]here[/url] or click the Discord icon below this post.[/p][/*][*][p]This August we'll be at [b]gamescom in Cologne[/b]! We couldn't be more excited to meet players, answer questions, and see you playtest our game. So if you're there, make sure to drop by and say Hi![/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for this Dev Log. We're eager to share even more exciting updates in the weeks to come!
Thanks for your support, and stay tuned for more![/p][p] - the Selkies Team 🦭 
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129050/Echoes_of_Mora/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
